info.name: Load, Generation, and Interchange Historical API

params.name: date
params.description: Market date in the form: yyyy-mm-dd

params.name: adjacentBa
params.description: Filter to a specific adjacent Balancing Authority (ex. PJM, TVA, SWPP).

params.name: interval
params.description: Filter to a specific time interval (ex. "13:05", "13"), in Eastern Standard Time (UTC−05:00).

items.docs: Net scheduled interchange (NSI) final volumes, by adjacent balancing authority (BA) in hourly intervals. Includes updates from Dynamic Schedules, Emergency Power Purchases, and ARS/CRSG events. Positive values indicate imports. Available at 7am EST the day after. May be updated up to 105 days after-the-fact.
